uncertain_variables.generate_stndrn_variable_set(sigmas)[source]

Generate a set of independent standard normal random variables with specified standard deviations.

Parameters:

sigmas (list or array_like) – Standard deviations for the independent standard normal random variables.

Returns:

Q – A set of independent standard normal random variables with specified standard deviations.
